title: AgentRequest
description: A request dispatched to one AI agent (architecture.md §9/§24). The LLM itself is not implemented yet — this defines the shape a future orchestrator must send.

agent_type.description: e.g. state_evaluator, vulnerability, tactical, regulatory, command — see agents/agents/.

simulation_state.description: A SimulationState object, or null if this agent doesn't need one (e.g. a RAG-only regulatory lookup).
